panels.title: Active alarms
panels.description: Alarms whose latest event is a raise from the board's current boot. A restart forgets every alarm, and one whose condition still holds is raised again once its hold has passed - so a raise from before the last boot is not shown here. Independent of the time range.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest_boot AS (SELECT boat_id, max(boot_id) AS boot_id FROM events WHERE boot_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY boat_id), latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (boat_id, subject) * FROM events WHERE kind = 'alarm' ORDER BY boat_id, subject, boot_id DESC, seq DESC) SELECT l.boat_id AS "Boat", l.subject AS "Alarm", l.severity AS "Severity", l.payload->>'sensor' AS "Sensor", (l.payload->>'value')::real AS "Reading", (l.payload->>'limit')::real AS "Limit", coalesce(l.ts, l.received_at) AS "Since" FROM latest l JOIN latest_boot b ON b.boat_id = l.boat_id AND b.boot_id = l.boot_id WHERE l.state = 'raised' ORDER BY "Since" DESC

panels.title: Events
panels.description: Everything the board reported in the selected range, newest first: boots, lost and returning sensors, knocks, alarms and acknowledgements. Time is the board's own; Clock says which clock that was. Event is the whole message as it arrived.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(ts, received_at) AS "Time", boat_id AS "Boat", kind AS "Kind", subject AS "About", state AS "State", severity AS "Severity", time_source AS "Clock", payload::text AS "Event" FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(coalesce(ts, received_at)) ORDER BY coalesce(ts, received_at) DESC, boot_id DESC, seq DESC LIMIT 500
